thread:
jordan: Quick Q — where should I pull logs/traces for the 502 burst yesterday on gateway-prod? want to attach a sample to the PR and also propose a minor alert debounce change.

mira: Dash links: Grafana > Gateway > Errors (https://grafana.redwood.local/d/gateway/errors). For traces check Jaeger service `gateway-ingress` (https://jaeger.redwood.local/search).

kevin: For logs start with Loki: `{app=\"gateway\", level=\"error\"} |= \"502\"` — timeframe 2026-03-16T22:00..23:00 if you want the spike window.

jordan: thanks. any quick pointer for a representative trace id i can paste in PR? also the alert noise is mostly from client IP churn — thinking about increasing the 502 alert threshold to 1% over 5m -> 3% over 10m, or add a short debounce.

mira: grabbed one: trace id `b3f9c4a2d7e1a6` — sample trace link: https://jaeger.redwood.local/trace/b3f9c4a2d7e1a6. Shows ingress timed out talking to runtime pool (span `runtime-proxy` with `deadline_exceeded`).

kevin: If it's mostly transient overload we can try: reduce alert to `>= 3%` over 10m + require >= 5 affected routes to fire. That cuts down on single-route/agent churn. Also add runbook link to alert.

alex: +1 on runbook. Also pinging @eng-oncall for visibility in case this recurs during rollout.

ops-bot: Incident alert: gateway-502-rate-high fired 2026-03-16T22:07 — suppressed by on-call debounce for 4m previously. (auto-note)

jordan: I'll open a tiny PR with the trace + Loki query + suggested alert change. Draft snippet for alert (promql-ish) I plan to use:
```
(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\",code=~\"5..\"}[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\"}[5m]))) * 100 >= 3
```
Then require `count(route where condition) >= 5` in the alerting layer. Thoughts?

mira: That looks good. Two minor asks: 1) add `client_ip` cardinality check in the dashboard so we can see churn, 2) include a note to fallback to model variant `v1-fallback` if runtime latency > 1s (helps degrade gracefully).

kevin: For debugging traces: if you need a quick curl to reproduce the timeout locally against staging:
```
curl -v -H \"x-request-id: test-502-001\" https://staging-gateway.redwood.local/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"hello\"}'
```

jordan: perfect — I'll file the PR and link it here. tagging @alex for review. I'll also add a small todo to update the dashboard panel to show `unique(client_ip)` over the same window.

alex: Got it — will review after stand. If it reduces noise let's roll the alert change next week. :thumbsup:

jordan: done — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821. Included trace, Loki query, and the alert patch. Please leave any review comments.

mira: Reviewed, left one comment about adding the runbook link. otherwise lgtm. :eyes:

kevin: lgtm from me too. If we still see recurrence after change we should consider auto-fallback to `small-queue` routing for heavy clients.

jordan: thanks all. closing the loop here — will follow up in the PR with any backfill metrics. :white_check_mark:
